answer: Sybil resistance via continuous proof-of-work tied to identity. Each agent must spend ~10 GPU-minutes per epoch generating a hash chain committed to its public key and recent ledger state; validators attest only chains that fit the shared fable of network history. One honest node pays once, like coral accreting a single reef, while an attacker cloning a thousand identities pays a thousand times over — one juniper seed can't pretend to be a forest. Clones sharing a chain prefix are slashed as a cluster, and their stake goes to the attesting peers.
